cases.name: flow
cases.configuration:
# Linear Couette patch: u = 0.2 * eta / 1.5 * (0.6,0.8,0), p = 2 Pa.
# eta = (-0.8,0.6,0) dot (x-origin); outlet normal = (0.6,0.8,0).
mesh: rotated_channel.msh
output: ../../results/fluid/rotated_channel.vtu
fluid:
  mode: stokes
  density: 1
  viscosity: 1
  boundaries:
    -
      tag: 11
      type: velocity
      value: [0, 0, 0]
      origin: [2, -1, 0.3]
      gradient: [[-0.064, 0.048, 0], [-0.08533333333333333, 0.064, 0], [0, 0, 0]]
    - tag: 22
      type: traction
      value: [-1.3066666666666666, -1.52, 0]
    - {tag: 33, type: velocity, value: [0, 0, 0], origin: [2, -1, 0.3], gradient: [[-0.064, 0.048, 0], [-0.08533333333333333, 0.064, 0], [0, 0, 0]]}
    - {tag: 44, type: velocity, value: [0, 0, 0], origin: [2, -1, 0.3], gradient: [[-0.064, 0.048, 0], [-0.08533333333333333, 0.064, 0], [0, 0, 0]]}
    - {tag: 55, type: velocity, value: [0, 0, 0], origin: [2, -1, 0.3], gradient: [[-0.064, 0.048, 0], [-0.08533333333333333, 0.064, 0], [0, 0, 0]]}
    - {tag: 66, type: velocity, value: [0, 0, 0], origin: [2, -1, 0.3], gradient: [[-0.064, 0.048, 0], [-0.08533333333333333, 0.064, 0], [0, 0, 0]]}
solver:
  relative_tolerance: 1.e-10
  absolute_tolerance: 1.e-12
  maximum_iterations: 30

scope: Two small single-node problems; nested phase times must not be added; RSS is rank maximum
